sprite.incarnation: Raiden in the cancelled Metal Gear Solid: Rising official E3 2010 full-body promotional render, separate from both the 2009 portrait and released 2013 Revengeance body.

sources.role: Original complete official Konami E3 2010 cancelled Rising Raiden render. Silver graphite augmented body, white hair, red eye, blue angular sword scabbard. 2013 MGR and MGS4 excluded.

limits: Entirely redrawn independent native pixel-art bodies of this exact incarnation; no derived pixel filter or source bitmap downsampling.

Exact cancelled E3 2010 Konami Rising Raiden prototype incarnation, silver/graphite cybernetic anatomy with silver angular armor, white hair and blue angular scabbard. Straight silver HF blade retained. Independently authored pixel motions. Physical10/11 hold the attested blade rather than a firearm, and12 is blade/body recovery, not a falsely certified ammunition reload. Inherited CQC projectile definitions remain adapted gameplay; actual blade-tip sockets do not certify a canonical ranged gun.

Entirely independently authored native pixel bodies and complete physical phases. No old painted atlas transformed/downsampled, no official extracted animation or MSX2 hardware16color certification. Native source art and exact source SHA/rect geometry retained.

Inherited CQC projectile definitions remain unchanged. Exact real source blade/barrel/empty-hand coordinates are isolated guarded-coordinate checks, not a claim of live projectile births or an invented canonical weapon.
Same UID/incarnation and original project worldscale retained; source art does not automatically publisher-certify estimated metre values.
